latest.summary: The Commission's AI Act page now frames the AI Act as an active implementation file: prohibited practices applied from February 2025, GPAI rules from August 2025, transparency rules from August 2026, and high-risk obligations staged through December 2027 and August 2028 after simplification/political agreement language.
